paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: Proportion of incorrectly answered samples where RPop_Ge is less than RPop_GT.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates the proportion of incorrectly answered samples where RPop_Ge is less than RPop_GT, categorized by three distinct domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis represents these three categories, arranged in the order listed, with no indication of a specific sorting criterion beyond their sequence in the legend. The vertical axis is labeled “Ratio (%)” and is scaled linearly from 50 to 90, with tick marks and grid lines at intervals of 10, indicating the percentage of incorrectly answered samples. Each category contains three bars, colored blue for Llama3, red for Qwen2, and yellow for ChatGPT, as indicated by the legend. For the “Movies” category, the blue bar reaches approximately 90%, the red bar is also at approximately 90%, and the yellow bar is at approximately 72%. For the “Songs” category, the blue bar is at approximately 84%, the red bar is at approximately 90%, and the yellow bar is at approximately 62%. For the “Basketball” category, the blue bar is at approximately 67%, the red bar is at approximately 58%, and the yellow bar is at approximately 61%. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and each bar represents an independent value for its respective model within each category. There is no visual emphasis applied to any specific bar, such as shading or bolding.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart, titled “Proportion of incorrectly answered samples where RPop_Ge is less than RPop_GT,” compares the performance of three large language models—Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow)—across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis displays these three categories in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis, labeled “Ratio (%)”, uses a linear scale ranging from 50 to 90, with tick marks and labels spaced at intervals of 10. For each category, three bars are presented side-by-side, representing the respective model’s ratio. In the “Movies” category, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 90%, the Qwen2 bar is also at approximately 90%, and the ChatGPT bar is at approximately 72%. In the “Songs” category, the Llama3 bar is approximately 84%, the Qwen2 bar is approximately 90%, and the ChatGPT bar is approximately 63%. In the “Basketball” category, the Llama3 bar is approximately 67%, the Qwen2 bar is approximately 58%, and the ChatGPT bar is approximately 61%. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the categories as labeled on the horizontal axis. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or annotations beyond their standard color coding and height.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Proportion von falsch beantworteten Beispielen, bei denen der RPop_Ge-Wert kleiner ist als der RPop_GT-Wert, für drei verschiedene Modelle – Llama3 (blau), Qwen2 (rot) und ChatGPT (gelb) – unterteilt nach drei Kategorien: „Movies“, „Songs“ und „Basketball“. Die horizontale Achse repräsentiert die Kategorien „Movies“, „Songs“ und „Basketball“ in dieser Reihenfolge von links nach rechts. Die vertikale Achse ist die „Ratio (%)“ und verläuft linear von 50 bis 90 in Schritten von 10. In der Kategorie „Movies“ erreichen die Balken für Llama3 und Qwen2 jeweils etwa 90%, während der Balken für ChatGPT etwa 72% beträgt. In der Kategorie „Songs“ beträgt der Wert für Llama3 etwa 84%, für Qwen2 etwa 90% und für ChatGPT etwa 62%. In der Kategorie „Basketball“ beträgt der Wert für Llama3 etwa 67%, für Qwen2 etwa 58% und für ChatGPT etwa 61%. Die Balken sind in jeder Gruppe nebeneinander angeordnet und nicht gestapelt. Es gibt keine besondere Sortierung der Kategorien oder visuelle Hervorhebung einzelner Balken.
